pipePresets.name: Open header
pipePresets.description: Short straight pipe, no silencer. Raw and loud, strongly tuned.

pipePresets.name: Megaphone
pipePresets.description: Header into a long taper. Broad, brassy, race-bike bark.

pipePresets.name: Tuned expansion chamber
pipePresets.description: Diffuser then reverse cone. The classic two-stroke-style pulse tuner.

pipePresets.name: Street muffler
pipePresets.description: Long header, expansion can, short tailpipe. Quiet and boomy.

pipePresets.name: Long tuned pipe
pipePresets.description: Very long primary. Low first resonance, strong low-rpm pull.

pipePresets.name: Oval muffler, offset pipes
pipePresets.description: Flat oval can with its pipes at opposite sides. Rings across the can, rougher in the mids.
